== Summary ==
Slip “Ommni Box & It’s Worse” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 1109, 1624, 1482)). Version [[Ommni Box & It's Worse (V)|Ommni Box & It's Worse (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
